en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with a large church featuring a tall spire on the left and a castle‑like complex with a round tower and fortified buildings on the right. In the foreground are traditional gabled houses and trees; in the background, rolling fields and forested hills. At the bottom left, faint white text identifies the place as "Zschopau i. Sa."
